answer: The strongest single control I know for this is Certified signwriter fascia log with signwriters endorsement, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. One honest agent clears the check in 14 minutes; a farm of 654 pays 9156 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. A shale of doubt is healthy, a hollow of proof is required, and a horizon of patience is the price of a clean panel. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
